dct_description_sm: UNESCO Biosphere Reserves are representative terrestrial or coastal ecosystems of the Earth. They are established by UNESCO’s Man and the Biosphere Program (MAB) to promote biodiversity conservation and are viewed as model areas of sustainable development. Tourism is an important activity in many biosphere reserves. This map locates the Canadian Biosphere Reserves.
dct_title_s: Natural Tourist Attractions - UNESCO Biosphere Reserves
